description: Search the daily summary of Spain's Official State Gazette (BOE) by keywords and section: laws, royal decrees, orders, grants, tenders (section 5A), public-exam calls (2B). Returns titles, issuing body and official PDF/HTML links. No issue on Sundays. Source: BOE open data API; not an official AEBOE service. Free: 20 calls per client per UTC day, shared by the Spain tools (es_pvpc_prices, es_boe_search). When the free quota is used up the tool returns an error naming the paid HTTP endpoint https://es.redtapeapi.com/v1/es/boe/search ($0.002 USDC per successful call over x402 on Base, no account or API key).

q.description: Keywords, Spanish works best; accent-insensitive; all terms must match

name: es_boe_search
title: Search Spain's Official State Gazette (BOE) for a day
